prose: Get ready to release the Kraken tonight as we crack into the deranged skull of H.P. Lovecraft and decode his C'Thonic mythology, its cultural influence, astrological significance, and symbolic strangeness. This super-panel live stream starring Slick Dissident (Gabriel), Juan from The Juan on Juan Podcast, Mario Garza from Symbolic Studies, and astrologer Kayleigh Berkana, might just leave you feeling the abyss staring back.
